mlb.sp_quality.rationale: Needs SIERA/xFIP/Stuff+/xwOBA-against: batted-ball (EV/LA, bb_type) and pitch shape (velo, spin, movement) fields that only the pitch/PA feed supplies; draft maps only 2024-25 box scores (2 seasons) and has no TRACKING need, so skill estimators with multi-season regression cannot be built from it.

mlb.sp_workload.rationale: raw says it is a readout of the shared exit hazard mlb.sp_hook_hazard_curve, not a separate model; draft treats it as raw-data input (AVAIL/NEWS/TEAM_BOX needs are incidental) so its status must be capped by the hazard curve.

mlb.lineup_pit.rationale: Confirmed batting order with first-appearance timestamp exists only as live lineup hydrate with no posting time (mlb.lineup_il_vintages: PROSPECTIVE_CAPTURE_ONLY); schedule_games lineups are as-played final values, so mapping LINEUP to schedule_games cannot provide timestamped vintages.

mlb.hitter_quality.rationale: Blend uses xwOBA, barrel%, EV by batter-hand split weighted by PA (BABIP stabilises ~800 PA): needs EV/LA hitData and multi-season PA-level events with pitcher hand; draft has no TRACKING need and uses the 2-season (2024-25) box-score archive.

mlb.platoon.rationale: Platoon split needs per-PA wOBA/K% vs same-handed pitchers (~1000 PA per batter): requires PA-level events with pitcher hand over many seasons (pe 2008-2025); boxscore_player has only 2024-25 and no pitcher-hand split.

mlb.park.rationale: Draft pulls spurious DRAFT (trigger "combine" in "combine with team home/road splits") and MARKET_RULES ("void"), and uses 2-season box scores; 3-year regressed park factors by outcome (1B,2B,3B,HR,K,BB) and batter hand need PA-level events (pe 2008-2025) plus venue dimensions.

mlb.umpire.rationale: Plate-umpire tendencies (called-strike rate over expected, UmpScorecards-style) need strike-zone pitch locations and an umpire-detail source (mlb.umpire_stats, FREE_UNPROBED); draft maps OFFICIALS to schedule_games which only carries the as-played home-plate umpire id, and marks status MEASURED.

mlb.defense.rationale: Raw needs fielder OAA/runs prevented and catcher framing runs (Statcast fielding/catch-probability tracking); draft maps only TEAM_BOX schedule_games and marks DATA_IN_HAND, which has no fielder-level or tracking fields. Confirmed starting defence also needs lineup vintages.

mlb.baserunning.rationale: Sprint speed and catcher pop time are Statcast-leaderboard tracking fields (statcast_bulk), not in the pitch/PA feed; draft maps TRACKING to pitch_pa_events.

mlb.rest_travel.rationale: Days since off day, day-after-night, doubleheader flag and games in last 7 days require the game schedule with dates and start times (schedule_games 2015-2025); draft maps only VENUE (coordinates) so the schedule need is missing.

mlb.run_dist.rationale: Negative-binomial / half-inning simulation with park, weather and pitching covariates is a derived model; pregame use of weather needs forecast, draft uses observed weather only.

mlb.pa_sim.rationale: Raw says Monte Carlo PA game engine built from batter, pitcher, park, umpire, weather inputs and a hook model: derived. RULES need is spurious ("hook rule" is a model component).

mlb.first_inning.rationale: Simulation of first three batters from confirmed lineup, starter first-TTO rates, park and weather: derived from other inputs; status must be capped by them.

mlb.f5_split.rationale: Simulates starter-only run distribution with hook probability and bullpen weights: derived from the hook hazard and PA simulation.

mlb.injuries_pit.rationale: Raw requires injury/late-scratch reports with report time and roster-status snapshots by date: timestamped vintages exist only as prospective capture (lineup_il_vintages, news_timestamped); mlb.transactions is date-only (time-of-day unknown) and has no late-scratch reports. Draft SAFE/MEASURED is optimistic.

mlb.opp_strength.rationale: Primary measurement is a ridge regression of team-game runs on offence, defence, park and home effects (team/venue data); lineup-sum wRC+ is only an alternative, so LINEUP need is incidental and drives a spurious leaky verdict.

mlb.season_sim.rationale: Monte Carlo of remaining games from run-differential ratings, projections and rotation: derived from other inputs.

mlb.news.rationale: Role-shift DiD relative to event timing needs announcement time; mlb.transactions is dated only (time-of-day unknown, EVENT_TIME date granularity), so PIT is coarse not safe.

mlb.hr_environment.rationale: HR factors by batter handedness, ball-regime by season and game-time wind/temperature: needs PA-level events (pe 2008-2025) not the 2-season box archive, and pregame wind/temperature are forecast values (WEATHER_FCST missing).

mlb.contact_defense.rationale: xBABIP from EV/LA mix and hard-hit/barrel rate against require hitData (TRACKING missing in draft); "defence behind the pitcher" is the defense input.

mlb.leash.rationale: Raw: not a separate model; leash is the manager random effect inside mlb.sp_hook_hazard_curve. RULES need is spurious (trigger "coefficient").

mlb.plate_discipline.rationale: Umpire adjustment and log5 combination are inputs/derived (mlb.umpire); OFFICIALS mapped to schedule_games only gives a home-plate id, not strike-zone tendencies.

mlb.first_inning_splits.rationale: Spurious DRAFT need: trigger is "combine" ("combine in PA simulation") not draft data; makes status prospective/UNAVAILABLE. Raw needs PA/pitch events and box lines only.

mlb.delay_risk.rationale: Needs hourly precipitation probability (forecast) and radar nowcast: WEATHER_FCST missing (draft only observed weather); AVAIL tx is spurious (roof/tarp status is not a transaction). Radar archive is not in the registry.
mlb.delay_risk.notes: radar nowcast history not covered by any registry dataset; forecast history 2022+

mlb.extras_prob.rationale: Probability from simulated run distributions calibrated to historic frequency: derived input.

mlb.series_context.rationale: Series model uses announced starters and bullpen availability: probable-pitcher announcements are vintage data (lineup_il_vintages, prospective), not transactions; model is derived from per-game win probabilities.

mlb.award_voting.rationale: Regression on WAR needs fWAR/bWAR (leaderboards_external) which draft omits; historical voting uses 2024-25 only box archive.

mlb.leader_race.rationale: Rest-of-season simulation per contender is derived from rate projections and qualification rules.

mlb.mention_text.rationale: OFFICIALS>schedule_games is spurious ("crew" = broadcast crew, not umpire crew). Needs broadcast transcripts with word counts per crew: no registry dataset provides them.

mlb.f3_split.rationale: Spurious RULES need: the trigger is the word "slot" (lineup slot), not rules text; raw needs PA-level outcomes by batter/pitcher plus confirmed lineup slots.

mlb.tto.rationale: Spurious DRAFT need (trigger "combine with exit probability"); TTO needs PA events and the hook model.

mlb.k_rates.rationale: Spurious DRAFT need ("combine via odds-ratio"); umpire/TTO/park adjustments are other inputs; OFFICIALS>schedule_games lacks umpire tendency data.

mlb.sb_context.rationale: Pitcher hold time/catcher pop time are Statcast tracking fields and "per opportunity" rates need base-state events; draft maps only 2-season box scores as DATA_IN_HAND.

mlb.contact_dist.rationale: Spurious RULES need: the trigger is the word "slot" (lineup slot), not rules text; distribution of hits/TB/RBI is simulated from per-PA probabilities and lineup-slot PA, i.e. derived.

mlb.lineup_whiff_by_pitch.rationale: Spurious RULES need: the trigger is the word "slot" (lineup slot), not rules text; ("slot weights").

mlb.lineup_k_platoon.rationale: Spurious RULES need: the trigger is the word "slot" (lineup slot), not rules text; trigger is "weighted by expected PA share by lineup slot"; also hand splits need PA-level events not 2-season box.

mlb.velo_trend.rationale: Spurious DRAFT ("combine with days of rest") and CONTRACTS ("extension" = release extension) needs; AVAIL is a flag output only. Needs pitch release speed/spin/extension (feed pitchData, extension 2020+) and temperature.

mlb.pitch_count_limit.rationale: Spurious CONTRACTS need (trigger "cap" = pitch cap). Needs timestamped manager statements (news) plus pitch counts and IL/layoff status.

mlb.sp_efficiency.rationale: Spurious CONTRACTS need (trigger "BF_cap"); opponent lineup P/PA uses confirmed lineup so pregame use is leaky with as-played lineups.

mlb.opp_pitches_per_pa.rationale: Spurious DRAFT ("combine") and RULES ("slot") needs make it UNAVAILABLE/prospective; needs pitch-level events and lineup.

mlb.opener_bulk_flag.rationale: "probable-pitcher vs confirmed starter changes" needs timestamped probable-pitcher vintages (lineup_il_vintages), not transactions; draft marks MEASURED/COARSE.

mlb.bullpen_talent.rationale: Stuff+/xFIP of relievers needs pitch-shape and batted-ball tracking fields (TRACKING missing in draft).

mlb.umpire_k_bb_effect.rationale: Zone area / called strikes above expected by location bin need pitch coordinates (pe) and an umpire-level source (umpire_stats); draft marks DATA_IN_HAND from schedule_games home-plate id + 2-season box.

mlb.wind_vector_park.rationale: Pregame wind needs forecast (WEATHER_FCST missing); roof status comes from team announcements (news), AVAIL tx is spurious (trigger "status").

mlb.air_density.rationale: pk=yes pregame feature but draft uses only observed weather (known after the fact, per registry); needs forecast for pregame and EVENT for HR/FB regression.

mlb.roof_state.rationale: Roof flag from team/venue announcements (timestamped news), not MLB transactions; AVAIL ("status") and RULES ("historical rule by forecast") are spurious.

mlb.forecast_precip_timing.rationale: Hourly PoP and radar nowcast around first pitch are forecast data (WEATHER_FCST missing in draft).
mlb.forecast_precip_timing.notes: radar nowcast archive not in registry

mlb.team_wrc_vs_hand.rationale: Spurious RULES need: the trigger is the word "slot" (lineup slot), not rules text; batter wRC+ vs LHP/RHP needs PA-level hand splits (pe), not the 2-season box archive.

mlb.hitter_contact_profile.rationale: Spurious DRAFT need (trigger "combine with K% and BB%"); xBA/xSLG/barrel from feed hitData (EV, LA, coordinates) is available, so status/PIT are too pessimistic.

mlb.bat_tracking.rationale: Bat speed, swing length, squared-up/blast are Savant bat-tracking fields (2023/2024+), not in the StatsAPI pitch feed; the draft maps TRACKING to pitch_pa_events and marks MEASURED/SAFE.

mlb.hitter_hr_profile.rationale: Raw lists Statcast launch_speed, launch_angle, spray angle, barrel flag but draft has no TRACKING need.

mlb.pitcher_hr_vulnerability.rationale: HR/FB, barrels allowed and fly-ball rate by batter hand need hitData and PA events; draft has only 2-season box scores.

mlb.pitcher_gb_rate.rationale: Needs Statcast bb_type counts (hitData trajectory) and OAA team defence; draft maps only box/team games.

mlb.expected_pa.rationale: Spurious RULES need: the trigger is the word "slot" (lineup slot), not rules text; distribution of PA by slot from historical games.

mlb.rbi_opportunity.rationale: On-base rate of hitters ahead and RBI per baserunner need lineup order and base-state events; draft maps box scores only (DATA_IN_HAND).

mlb.run_scoring_opportunity.rationale: Spurious RULES need: the trigger is the word "slot" (lineup slot), not rules text; raw also needs PA-level events with base-out state, missing in draft.

mlb.hitter_speed.rationale: Sprint speed (Statcast competitive runs) is a leaderboard tracking field in statcast_bulk (FREE_BLOCKED_FROM_RUNNER), not in the StatsAPI feed; draft marks MEASURED/SAFE.

mlb.hitter_recent_form.rationale: Rolling xwOBA and barrel% need EV/LA hitData (TRACKING missing); draft only has AVAIL and team games.

mlb.bvp_history.rationale: Career head-to-head requires PA-level history with pitcher/batter ids across all seasons (pe 2008-2025, Retrosheet); boxscore_player has only 2024-25.

mlb.babip_luck.rationale: xBA/xBABIP on BIP needs hitData (TRACKING) and ~800 BIP = multi-season history; PROJECTIONS is spurious (own expected-value use).

mlb.lob_strand_luck.rationale: Expected LOB% needs base-out mix and K/HR rates per PA, i.e. event-level data, not 2-season box scores.

mlb.hrfb_regression.rationale: Raw needs Statcast batted balls with fly-ball classification (hitData trajectory); draft has no TRACKING/EVENT need and 2-season box.

mlb.team_style.rationale: Pinch-hit and bunt logs need event-level data (substitutions, bunt events); draft has only lineups/box.

mlb.remaining_sos.rationale: Raw uses team talent posteriors, i.e. a derived input.

mlb.depth_injury_war.rationale: Starters projected WAR vs replacement requires projection vintages (PROJECTIONS missing); availability distribution needs IL vintages.

mlb.award_stats_war.rationale: Raw: WAR from both systems (fWAR/bWAR) -> leaderboards_external (RATINGS_EXT) missing from draft.

mlb.award_narrative.rationale: Narrative flags (milestone, comeback, first-year) need contemporaneous reports, not MLB transactions; WAR rank needs leaderboards.

mlb.rest_of_season_projection.rationale: Per-contender simulation from games remaining, P(play), PA per game and regressed rates: derived from projection/rate inputs.

mlb.broadcast_crew.rationale: OFFICIALS>schedule_games is spurious: "crew" here is the TV/radio broadcast crew, not umpire crew; broadcast identity comes from broadcaster archives (news_press), not transactions.

mlb.game_narrative_triggers.rationale: Pregame storylines (milestones, debuts) come from timestamped news; AVAIL/transactions mapping is incidental.

mlb.seller_buyer_status.rationale: Playoff odds (own season simulation), contract years (contracts) and rumours: derived from the season sim.

mlb.service_time_rules.rationale: Raw is a rule calendar plus per-player option/40-man/service data -> contracts/service reference; EVENT and PLAYER_BOX needs are incidental ("per-play" trigger). Per-player option status has no as-of vintages.

mlb.series_game_state.rationale: Probable starters and bullpen availability are vintaged announcements (lineup_il_vintages), not transactions.

m.rules_text.rationale: Spurious EVENT need (trigger "overtime" in extracted rule flags); input is the Kalshi rules text only.

m.lifecycle.rationale: Spurious AVAIL ("status transitions" of the Kalshi market). Needs Kalshi open/close times and the scheduled/actual start from the schedule feed.

m.strike_hit_rates.rationale: Compares realized hit rates to implied price by price bucket: uses Kalshi prices, i.e. a market-derived benchmark that the catalog missed; cannot be a market-free input.

mlb.season_sim_distribution.rationale: Monte Carlo from own run-differential ratings, rotation and tiebreak rules: derived.

mlb.leader_order_statistic.rationale: Simulation of each contender from rate x playing-time with injury hazards: derived.

mlb.clinched_rest_policy.rationale: Needs standings (clinch/elimination state, days remaining) -> TEAM_BOX missing; AVAIL ("status") is spurious; lineup at decision time needs lineup vintages.

mlb.sp_k_dispersion_start_effect.rationale: Raw uses per-batter expected K from the matchup model: derived.

mlb.battery_assignment.rationale: Catcher framing runs per called pitch is another input (catcher_framing); catcher assignment requires the lineup card.

mlb.abs_challenge_regime.rationale: Spurious AVAIL ("challenges remaining" matches availab). ABS challenge events exist only for 2026 regular season (regime data starts 2026); rules for allotment need rules reference.

mlb.exit_boundary_mass.rationale: Raw: exit-outs lattice readout of the shared starter exit hazard, not separate raw data: derived.

mlb.outs_per_bf_dp_baserunning.rationale: Catcher pop time and runner sprint speed are Statcast leaderboards (statcast_bulk), not StatsAPI feed fields.

mlb.opposing_lineup_out_rate_profile.rationale: Spurious RULES need: the trigger is the word "slot" (lineup slot), not rules text; raw needs confirmed lineup and projections by hand.

mlb.er_ur_scoring_split.rationale: Passed balls and fielding errors by position are event-level fields; draft maps only box scores and team game (DATA_IN_HAND).

mlb.pa_split_sp_vs_pen.rationale: Share of PA against starter vs relievers is derived from the hook hazard and bullpen availability.

mlb.park_specific_xhr.rationale: Needs batted-ball EV/LA/spray (TRACKING missing) and pregame wind/temperature (forecast missing).

mlb.game_shared_hr_dispersion.rationale: pk=yes with wind/temperature/roof: pregame needs weather forecast (missing); 2-season box scores insufficient for dispersion estimate.

mlb.pa_base_out_state_chain.rationale: Markov chain needs PA-level events with base-out state (EVENT missing in draft); derived from park, lineup and hitter inputs.

mlb.rbi_conversion_by_runner_base.rationale: Raw is PA-level base-out state and RBI credited; 2-season box scores have no base state.

mlb.sb_opportunity_conversion.rationale: Opportunity-level steal hazard needs sprint speed and pop time (statcast_bulk).

mlb.batting_behind_protection.rationale: Spurious RULES need: the trigger is the word "slot" (lineup slot), not rules text; projections by hand needed.

mlb.lineup_strength_delta.rationale: Spurious RULES need: the trigger is the word "slot" (lineup slot), not rules text; confirmed lineup vs team baseline needs projections by hand.

mlb.home_field_run_advantage.rationale: Game log home/away runs by park needs the results schedule (TEAM_BOX/RESULTS) which draft lacks.

mlb.extras_run_contribution.rationale: Spurious CONTRACTS need (trigger "contract" in "contribution"/rules); needs linescores and rule-regime reference.

mlb.series_length_distribution.rationale: Uses per-game pregame win probability from the project model: derived.

mlb.f5_starter_change_risk.rationale: Needs announced probable pitcher by timestamp (lineup_il_vintages, prospective) and IL status vintages; draft maps to transactions and marks MEASURED/SAFE.

mlb.f5_lineup_slot_exposure.rationale: Spurious RULES need: the trigger is the word "slot" (lineup slot), not rules text; needs projections by hand.

mlb.f5_reliever_innings_share.rationale: Raw: expected reliever share of first five innings is a readout of the hook hazard/exit model: derived.

mlb.first_inning_markov_run_prob.rationale: Spurious RULES need: the trigger is the word "slot" (lineup slot), not rules text; Markov chain is derived from PA state chain and first-inning splits.

mlb.ninth_inning_entry_and_pitcher.rationale: Spurious RULES need: the trigger is the word "slot" (lineup slot), not rules text; raw needs inning-level score and pitcher usage.

mlb.team_run_correlation_tie_mass.rationale: Wind and temperature as pregame covariates need forecast; tie mass from correlated run model is derived.

mlb.tie_entering_ninth_resolution.rationale: Spurious RULES need: the trigger is the word "slot" (lineup slot), not rules text; ("due-up slots").

mlb.lightning_proximity_exposure.rationale: Raw needs lightning strike/flash timestamps and coordinates (GOES-R GLM / NLDN) which no registry dataset provides; draft maps weather forecast/observed only.

mlb.word_rate_per_broadcast_hour.rationale: Needs game-crew-word counts with exposure hours from transcripts; OFFICIALS>schedule_games is spurious (broadcast crew).

mlb.broadcast_airtime_distribution.rationale: Network schedule and show windows are broadcaster data (news_press), not MLB transactions; durations/delays come from game feed.

mlb.player_involvement_mention_rate.rationale: Transcript mentions by player are required (no registry dataset); draft maps lineups/box only.

mlb.sponsor_read_inventory.rationale: Raw needs transcript segments classified for sponsor reads plus network/daypart; draft maps RESULTS>schedule_games, which contains none of it.

mlb.manager_wins_over_expectation.rationale: Preseason projected wins (PROJECTIONS vintage) is required and missing; award votes need BBWAA results.

mlb.sale_process_stage_hazard.rationale: Franchise-sale stage timestamps and league approvals are business news, not MLB player transactions (mlb.transactions); EVENT pitch data is spurious.

mlb.mlbb_team_rating_series_format.rationale: MLBB = Mobile Legends esports, not baseball: MLB pitch events/box scores/schedule contain nothing about it; needs esports match results (map results, drafts, patches), none in registry.

mlb.manager_candidate_selection_signal.rationale: Needs vacancy log, interview reports (timestamped news) and candidate/executive career histories (staff history); AVAIL is spurious ("status").

mlb.late_scratch_hazard.rationale: Raw needs lineup snapshots by timestamp and injury flags at post time (lineup_il_vintages, prospective); draft maps final as-played lineups.

mlb.rehab_progression_stage.rationale: Needs MiLB rehab-assignment logs (minors stats) and own-captured stage reports; draft maps MLB transactions/box only.

mlb.window_exposure_schedule.rationale: Participation probabilities and expected PA per game are outputs of other inputs: derived; needs schedule.

mlb.pitcher_rotation_slot_and_rest.rationale: Needs timestamped probable-pitcher announcements (own capture, lineup_il_vintages); RULES spurious ("slot").

mlb.callup_eligibility_pipeline.rationale: Needs 40-man roster status, MiLB logs and option years; LINEUP>schedule_games (depth chart trigger) is wrong; MiLB logs and depth charts are not in MLB datasets.

mlb.news_source_reliability_score.rationale: Needs report-level reporter/text/timestamp archive (timestamped news, prospective); mlb.transactions only provides the official dates to compare against.

mlb.calendar_hazard_by_event_type.rationale: Spurious EVENT pitch data; eligible-stock counts and calendar anchors are rules/contract reference, transactions give dated events.

mlb.manager_firing_hazard.rationale: AVAIL is spurious ("status"); preseason projected wins (PROJECTIONS) and change events (news) missing.

mlb.destination_selection_signal.rationale: LINEUP>schedule_games is spurious (trigger "depth chart"); projected AAV by player needs projections and rumours need timestamped news.

mlb.team_talent_posterior_uncertainty.rationale: Combines team results with projection vintages: derived.

mlb.postseason_adjusted_team_rating.rationale: Player-level projections, playoff roster and reliever usage: derived from player-level inputs.

mlb.deadline_roster_strength_shift.rationale: LINEUP>schedule_games is spurious ("depth chart"); needs transactions plus ROS projection vintages at each transaction date.

mlb.bracket_path_enumeration.rationale: Spurious LINEUP ("pairing"); needs the postseason format table (rules) and series results.

mlb.series_mvp_credit_share.rationale: P(team wins series) x credit share: derived; player WPA/RE24 needs PA-level events, pre-series WAR needs leaderboards.

mlb.playoff_games_pa_distribution.rationale: Spurious RULES need: the trigger is the word "slot" (lineup slot), not rules text; derived from bracket-path and PA expectation.

mlb.award_vote_rank_model.rationale: Features include fWAR/bWAR (leaderboards_external, RATINGS_EXT) missing in draft.

mlb.award_timing_information_state.rationale: Spurious SCHEME ("formation"); needs award calendar (ballot/finalist dates), not pitch events.

mlb.monthly_window_production_rank.rationale: Daily lines for windows need multi-season event/box data and own playoff-odds simulation (derived).

mlb.triple_crown_joint_probability.rationale: Derived from ROS projections and qualification rules.

mlb.all_star_selection_model.rationale: Fan-vote phase tallies with timestamps are not in any registry dataset; SCHEME ("route") is spurious.

mlb.all_star_game_event_model.rationale: ASG box scores 2000-2025 exceed the 2024-25 archive (pe covers 2008+); roster announcements timestamped.

mlb.draft_lottery_odds_by_record.rationale: The DRAFT dataset (prospect boards) is spurious; lottery odds table and restrictions are rules text plus prior-year standings.

mlb.award_combo_joint_distribution.rationale: Joint distribution of award outcomes is built on award-model outputs: derived; AVAIL spurious.

mlb.team_season_extreme_engine.rationale: Order-statistic engine from team projections and ratings: derived.

mlb.joint_season_hr_sb_distribution.rationale: Sprint speed is Statcast leaderboard (statcast_bulk); projections as-of dates and IL status required.

mlb.series_exact_score_distribution.rationale: Raw uses per-game probabilities from the series model: derived; DATA_IN_HAND is too optimistic.

mlb.longest_streak_extreme_value.rationale: Extreme-value distribution given team win probabilities: derived from team strength.

mlb.league_team_talent_posteriors_with_v.rationale: Posteriors built from preseason projection vintages and run differential: derived.

mlb.special_event_team_selection_affinit.rationale: Needs club coordinates and distances (venue) and TV-market data; draft maps RESULTS only.

mlb.wbc_national_team_strength.rationale: WBC results/rosters 2006-2026 are not in MLB regular-season archives (events 2008-2025, box 2024-25); needs a WBC dataset.

mlb.postseason_league_hr_count.rationale: Weather by game for pregame use needs forecast; count is derived from HR environment and bracket path.

mlb.asg_roster_participation_plan.rationale: Roster announcements/withdrawals with timestamps are news, not player transactions; RULES spurious ("slot").

mlb.hr_derby_field_and_withdrawal.rationale: Derby invitations/replacements with announcement dates need timestamped news; AVAIL and EVENT are spurious.

mlb.hr_derby_bracket_throughput_model.rationale: Swing-level derby log (EV, distance, take/swing, BP pitcher) is Statcast derby tracking (statcast_bulk) and per-year rulebooks; CONTRACTS spurious ("extension"); 2026 swing-capped format has no history.
mlb.hr_derby_bracket_throughput_model.notes: 2026 swing-capped format has one year of data

mlb.hr_derby_distance_ev_extreme.rationale: Derby batted balls are Statcast-tracked (registry: "Derby tracking is Statcast"); StatsAPI regular-season feed does not cover them.

mlb.hr_derby_bp_pitcher_pairing.rationale: BP pitcher chosen by each hitter is announced in media, not in awards results or pitch events.

mlb.futures_game_prospect_strength.rationale: Needs minor-league batting/pitching lines by level and Futures Game rosters; MLB box scores do not hold them; DRAFT spurious.

mlb.cba_bargaining_positions.rationale: Needs timestamped statements and proposals (news); player box scores are spurious.

mlb.lockout_precedent_reference_class.rationale: Episode table spans 1972-2022 stoppages; schedule_games covers 2015-2025 only: manual reference required.

mlb.games_per_calendar_day_makeup_map.rationale: Schedule by date and doubleheader inventory need the schedule feed (RESULTS), not only venue.

mlb.impasse_replacement_legal_state.rationale: Dated legal/NLRB events and replacement-player announcements are not MLB transactions.

mlb.postseason_roster_reset_eligibility.rationale: Postseason roster submissions per round are not in transactions; need captured announcements.

mlb.series_starter_assignment_by_game.rationale: Probable starters by game with timestamps (lineup_il_vintages), not derivable from pitch events.

mlb.series_per_game_win_prob_vector.rationale: Per-game win probability from probable starters, relievers and lineups: derived from other inputs.

mlb.prospect_scouting_performance_profil.rationale: College/summer/showcase lines are amateur data absent from MLB pitch/box datasets.

mlb.club_draft_tendency.rationale: Front-office personnel tenure dates require staff history; SCHEME ("personnel") spurious.

mlb.draft_sequential_selection_model.rationale: Sequential choice engine built on club tendency, board and draft order inputs: derived.

mlb.max_effort_pitch_exposure.rationale: Remaining exposure uses playoff probabilities and the velocity candidate pool: derived.

mlb.velocity_tracking_calibration.rationale: Repeated pulls of same games at different dates require vintage snapshots, only possible by own capture.

mlb.velocity_feed_anomaly_rate.rationale: Live-feed pitch snapshots with capture timestamp and Savant re-pulls at +1,+7,+30 days exist only through prospective capture.

mlb.pitcher_role_effort_regime.rationale: Club role announcements (own capture) are news, not transactions.

mlb.pitcher_k_talent_prior.rationale: Raw lists arm_angle, release_extension, spin (Statcast) -> TRACKING missing; CONTRACTS spurious ("release_extension").

mlb.opposing_probable_starter_vintage.rationale: Needs probable-pitcher snapshots with first_seen_ts/change_ts (lineup_il_vintages); schedule_games holds only the final value.

mlb.award_electorate_procedure.rationale: Electorate/ballot procedure (n voters, points vector, deadlines) is document data -> rules reference; awards results lack it.

mlb.award_fan_vote_popularity.rationale: All-Star phase-1 vote totals by player are not in awards results; box scores are spurious.

mlb.executive_award_team_improvement.rationale: Transaction log with player fWAR before/after needs leaderboards (RATINGS_EXT); box scores spurious.

mlb.leaguewide_rare_game_event_hazard.rationale: Spurious DRAFT need (trigger "combine"); needs league-season counts of rare events from events/box.

mlb.any_pitcher_season_wins_threshold.rationale: Needs probable-pitcher rotation and start-level score at exit; 2-season box does not hold the current season; derived from hook/workload models.

mlb.postseason_round_roster_membership.rationale: Roster submissions with submitted_ts are not in transactions; need captured announcements.

mlb.hr_distance_tail_exceedance.rationale: Needs hit_distance_sc/launch_speed/launch_angle (hitData) -> TRACKING missing in draft.

mlb.bases_loaded_pa_opportunity.rationale: Spurious RULES need: the trigger is the word "slot" (lineup slot), not rules text; needs PA-level base-out events (missing) and is a Markov chain derived from the PA state chain.

mlb.season_feat_ledger_state.rationale: Ledger is current-season (feats-to-date); boxscore_player archive ends 2025 and covers only 2 seasons, so DATA_IN_HAND is wrong; needs a fresh pull via the feed.

mlb.reliever_award_production.rationale: Raw lists fWAR, FIP-, gmLI, WPA: WAR/FIP- leaderboards missing; WPA/LI from events.

mlb.special_event_game_staging.rationale: AVAIL is spurious; announcements of venue status are timestamped news.

registry_objections.objection: Registry history is 2024-2025 only (142,822 rows) while many catalog inputs need 3-10 season regressions; status COLLECTED_ARCHIVE cannot satisfy those, so I mapped long-history needs to mlb.pitch_pa_events (2008-2025, reachable) instead.
Registry pit EVENT_TIME/observed-after-the-fact; fine, but no pregame forecast history before 2022 exists in env.weather_forecast_pit, so forecast-dependent inputs have ~4 seasons of PIT history.
